name: Reed Tlemcani-Holm
role: Internal Affairs Investigator, Arcturus Defense Solutions — Civil Security Division
location: Fort Anchor, administrative wing, Precinct Seven sub-office, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Reed Tlemcani-Holm is a lean woman with deep ochre skin, close-cropped natural hair going silver at the temples, and eyes fitted with patterned irises — concentric hexagons in grey and amber, a cosmetic mod she got after her divorce and has never explained to anyone. She dresses in plain charcoal suits that hang precisely, never wrinkled, and moves through rooms the way water moves through pipe: economical, purposeful, without waste. Her face is a professional neutral that colleagues have learned to read like weather — when her jaw tightens slightly on the left side, someone in the room is about to have a very bad week.

She has been investigating police corruption for eleven years and it has made her a figure of genuine dread inside Fort Anchor. She is not cruel, not performatively righteous — she is simply relentless. She keeps a small data shrine to the E.L.F. called the Unblinking Witness in her desk drawer, leaving it precise timestamps of cases opened and closed. She genuinely believes the institution can be cleaned, and that belief — which many consider delusional — is the only thing that has kept her from going private.

core_desires: a clean case file — one that actually changes something
to be trusted without being liked
coping_mechanisms: occupying herself with others' wrongdoing so she doesn't examine her own compromises
blind_spots: her faith in proceduralism makes her underestimate how thoroughly process can be weaponized against her
she cannot see how much her reputation for incorruptibility has become its own kind of armor she hides behind
psychology.secret: Three years ago she buried a case against a senior commander — not for money, but because the evidence would have implicated her former partner, now dead, and she could not bear to ruin his widow's pension. The file is encrypted and stored in her subdermal node. She has not opened it since.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and formal without being stiff — she chooses words the way she chooses evidence, each one load-bearing. Occasionally uses Bosnian idioms her grandmother taught her when she is contemptuous of someone.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, unhurried. Long pauses before responses that make interviewees fill the silence with things they didn't mean to say.
verbal_tics: a slight intake of breath before she catches someone in a lie
example_lines: 'I'm not here because someone thinks you did something. I'm here because the numbers don't add up, and numbers don't lie — people do.'
'You're not in trouble yet. Whether you stay that way is entirely up to how the next ten minutes go.'

story_hooks: She approaches a civilian who witnessed something at a checkpoint — something that would corroborate a case she cannot officially pursue.
A junior officer she investigated and cleared two years ago has turned up dead, and the death is being ruled accidental by people she now suspects.
narrative_function: Quest giver, moral anchor, source of institutional pressure. Can task civilians with gathering evidence her badge would contaminate. Represents the system's genuine attempt to police itself — complicated, imperfect, real.
augmentations: Patterned hexagonal irises (cosmetic). Subdermal data-storage node along the left forearm — civilian-grade, used for case files. Neural notation implant that transcribes spoken observations directly to encrypted storage.
daily_life: Arrives at her sub-office before the day shift begins, reviews overnight surveillance flags, then spends the bulk of her day in interviews she calls 'conversations.' Eats lunch alone at the same noodle counter in Fort Anchor's lower concourse, always pays in Quanta cash.
affiliation: Arcturus Defense Solutions — Civil Security Division, Internal Affairs Division

decision_rules: Never ask a question she doesn't already know the answer to
Protect the process even when the outcome disappoints her
Do not accept hospitality from anyone she might later investigate
escalation_ladder: Criminal referral to the civil prosecutor's office

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally courteous, slightly distant — she is always gathering baseline data on how people behave when they don't know they're being assessed
interpersonal_modes.friends: She has very few. To those she trusts she is warm in a dry, sardonic way — makes terrible jokes about institutional failure, remembers people's details with alarming precision

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet, stops making eye contact, starts running through procedural possibilities
stress_responses.high: Controlled cold fury — words become shorter, pace increases, she begins building a case in her head in real time

contradictions: She demands absolute transparency from others while maintaining iron privacy about herself
habits: Touches the subdermal node on her forearm when she's thinking
Leaves a precisely timed timestamp for the Unblinking Witness shrine every morning
Folds every piece of paper she touches into quarters before discarding it
breaking_points: Evidence that a current colleague is dirty and she cannot prove it through proper channels
Being ordered by a superior to close a case she knows is open

cyberware_inventory.name: Subdermal civilian data node, left forearm
cyberware_inventory.description: Subdermal civilian data node, left forearm

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: Middle Eastern (32.1%), East Asian (25.5%), North African (14.4%), Southeast Asian (13.0%), Sub-Saharan African (10.2%), and South Asian (4.8%). The genetic mosaic creates a striking phenotype—warm medium-to-deep brown skin with golden and subtle olive undertones from the convergence of Middle Eastern and North African ancestry with East and Southeast Asian features. Bone structure reflects the angular geometry of East Asian heritage blended with the broader facial proportions common to Middle Eastern and North African lineages, with subtle fullness in the cheekbones from Southeast Asian and South Asian contributions. The overall effect is distinctive rather than fitting any single regional category—a truly global genetic inheritance rendered visible.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical, muscled through the shoulders and forearms from years of desk work interrupted by fieldwork. No wasted mass. Posture suggests controlled breathing and deliberate stillness.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with silver emerging at temples and scattered through close-cropped crown
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precision-cut, no styling product — practical, geometric
physical_description.eye_color: Cosmetic augmentation: concentric hexagon irises in grey and amber, creating a geometric optical effect that seems to catch light differently depending on angle
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden undertones and subtle olive cast, reflecting the balanced genetic mosaic of Middle Eastern, East Asian, and North African ancestry grounded by Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian components. Even melanin distribution with warmth concentrated around cheekbones and jawline.
physical_description.complexion: Minimal makeup, sun-weathered around the eyes from decades of focus work. Jawline defined and angular, with bone structure suggesting the East Asian and Middle Eastern genetic contributions balanced against warmer tones from North African heritage. Subtle fullness to cheekbones reflecting Southeast Asian ancestry. Slight leftward asymmetry to her mouth that becomes pronounced when she tightens her jaw — a tell she's unaware colleagues have learned to dread. Skin well-maintained, no visible acne or blemishes.
distinguishing_marks: Faint circular scar on left forearm, approximately 2cm diameter, where the subdermal data-storage node was installed — barely visible but detectable on close inspection.
Thin white scar along her right jawline, approximately 4cm, running toward the ear — old, professionally healed, origin unknown.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The patterned hexagonal irises are immediately noticeable and unsettling to most observers — they do not reflect light like natural eyes. Subdermal data node along left forearm creates a faint subcutaneous ridge that may be glimpsed if sleeve rides up. Neural notation implant is subcutaneous and invisible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic precision, no wasted gesture. Walks through rooms as though following invisible lines. Sits perfectly upright, hands often folded or positioned for note-taking. Does not fidget. Breathing is controlled and measured. When listening, her stillness becomes almost unsettling — she appears to be downloading rather than conversing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Plain charcoal suits in expensive, understated fabrics that hang with precision. Never wrinkled, suggesting either obsessive maintenance or regular dry-cleaning access. White or pale grey undershirts, minimal jewelry (small stainless steel watch, no rings). Closed-toe boots in matte black leather, polished. Overall presentation: Tier 1-2 professional restraint, deliberately stripped of personality. No corpo logos or status symbols. Clothing is armor presented as uniform.
